basics.name: Anupam Chugh
basics.label: iOS & macOS engineer
basics.summary: Reliable iOS and Android developer who knows how to deliver results in the alignment of a company's mission. Led Android at Agricx and shipped their first iOS app, was managing editor of Better Programming, and since 2024 ships small Apple apps.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Ships small Apple apps to the App Store. See apps.json for the current list.

work.name: Better Programming
work.summary: Took over Better Programming from Zack Shapiro in 2021 and handed it to Mihai Banulescu in 2023. With a small editor team, read thousands of submissions a month.

work.summary: Led Android and shipped the company's first iOS app.
